preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Excess Balances'

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT l.id AS loanId, l.account_no AS accountNo, c.display_name AS clientName, COALESCE(o.name, co.name) AS officeName, l.currency_code AS currency, l.total_overpaid_derived AS excessBalance, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(t.transaction_date) FROM m_loan_transaction t WHERE t.loan_id = l.id AND t.is_reversed = 0 AND t.overpayment_portion_derived > 0), l.closedon_date, CURDATE())) AS daysOverpaid FROM m_loan l LEFT JOIN m_client c ON c.id = l.client_id LEFT JOIN m_office o ON o.id = l.office_id LEFT JOIN m_office co ON co.id = c.office_id WHERE l.total_overpaid_derived > 0 ORDER BY excessBalance DESC

column.name: description
column.value: Loans with outstanding excess / overpayment balances

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Refund Requests and Statuses'

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT r.id AS refundId, l.account_no AS accountNo, c.display_name AS clientName, r.amount, r.currency_code AS currency, r.status_enum AS status, r.payment_mode_enum AS paymentMode, r.hub_request_id AS hubRequestId, r.manual_payment_ref AS manualPaymentRef, r.paid_on AS paidOn, r.submitted_at AS submittedAt, u.username AS submittedBy FROM m_loan_excess_refund r JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = r.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_client c ON c.id = r.client_id LEFT JOIN m_appuser u ON u.id = r.submitted_by ORDER BY r.submitted_at DESC

column.name: description
column.value: Excess refund requests with workflow status

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Aging of Excess Balances'

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT l.account_no AS accountNo, c.display_name AS clientName, COALESCE(o.name, co.name) AS officeName, l.total_overpaid_derived AS excessBalance, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(t.transaction_date) FROM m_loan_transaction t WHERE t.loan_id = l.id AND t.is_reversed = 0 AND t.overpayment_portion_derived > 0), CURDATE())) AS ageDays, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(t.transaction_date) FROM m_loan_transaction t WHERE t.loan_id = l.id AND t.is_reversed = 0 AND t.overpayment_portion_derived > 0), CURDATE())) <= 30 THEN '0-30' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(t.transaction_date) FROM m_loan_transaction t WHERE t.loan_id = l.id AND t.is_reversed = 0 AND t.overpayment_portion_derived > 0), CURDATE())) <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(t.transaction_date) FROM m_loan_transaction t WHERE t.loan_id = l.id AND t.is_reversed = 0 AND t.overpayment_portion_derived > 0), CURDATE())) <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END AS agingBucket FROM m_loan l LEFT JOIN m_client c ON c.id = l.client_id LEFT JOIN m_office o ON o.id = l.office_id LEFT JOIN m_office co ON co.id = c.office_id WHERE l.total_overpaid_derived > 0 ORDER BY ageDays DESC

column.name: description
column.value: Aging buckets for loans with excess balances

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Excess Balance Reconciliation Report'

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT l.account_no AS accountNo, c.display_name AS clientName, l.total_overpaid_derived AS cbsExcess, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM m_loan_excess_refund r WHERE r.loan_id = l.id AND r.status_enum NOT IN (500, 600, 700)), 0) AS openRefundAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM m_loan_excess_refund r WHERE r.loan_id = l.id AND r.status_enum = 500), 0) AS postedRefundAmount, (l.total_overpaid_derived - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM m_loan_excess_refund r WHERE r.loan_id = l.id AND r.status_enum = 500), 0)) AS unreconciledExcess FROM m_loan l LEFT JOIN m_client c ON c.id = l.client_id WHERE l.total_overpaid_derived > 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_loan_excess_refund r WHERE r.loan_id = l.id) ORDER BY cbsExcess DESC

column.name: description
column.value: Reconcile CBS excess balances against open and posted refunds
